title: Book Two · Chapter 19: Back on the Shelf
story:
On Friday morning, Ronan brings the green goat book back to school. He looks inside the book first. There are no loose paper scraps between its pages. His three little signs are at home.

Miss Wu has a small box of book cards on her desk. Ronan finds the title of the green book. His name is on the first line.

“Do I cross it out?” he asks.

“Leave your name there. Put the return date beside it.”

He writes the date. Miss Wu checks the date. Then she checks the cover and turns a few pages.

“All right. Back on the shelf.”

Ronan takes the book to the short stories. Another child is waiting nearby. She points to the goat.

“Can I have that one?”

“You need its card.”

Ronan finds the card in Miss Wu's box again. He gives it to the child and moves aside.

She opens at the last picture. Ronan almost tells her about the two signs. Then he stops. She is looking for herself.

The child laughs at the high wall.

“Can the goat climb?” she asks.

Ronan thinks about the picture. It is a very tall wall.

“Not in this story.”

She takes the book to Miss Wu. Ronan watches her write her own name below his. His line stays on the card. Now there is room for another person's turn.

Jun is keeping the grey book for a few more days. Miss Wu agrees and writes a new date. Ronan wants the fishing story next, but he needs to wait.

“Do you finish with the second shoe?” he asks Jun.

“Not telling.”

Jun smiles. Ronan pushes his shoulder gently. Then they go out for break together.

After break, Miss Wu puts two empty chairs near her desk. She asks the class to look up from their books.

“Next Tuesday, we start a short story task. You will work in pairs. Two children will read and tell a story together.”

“Can I sit with Leo?” Ronan asks.

“Wait for Tuesday. I will arrange the pairs then. I will give you the pages then, too.”

Leo is looking at Jun. Jun is looking at Ronan. Mei turns her pencil between her hands. Nobody moves to another seat.

“Are we reading today?” Mei asks.

“We still have today's lesson,” Miss Wu says. “Put the task away for now. Open your school books.”

Ronan writes Tuesday in the corner of his notebook. Then he puts his pencil down and finds the right page.

After school, Leo waits for his mother at the gate. The reading activity is tomorrow morning. His mother wants him to have his pencils ready tonight.

“Will you bring your red book?” Ronan asks.

“I don't know. Mum has the note. I'll check it at home.”

“Can I see your new page afterward?”

“Yes. After the activity.”

At home, Ronan looks at Mr Qiu's blue animal book. It needs to go back tomorrow. He turns one last page. A little dog is pulling at a slipper. The other slipper is already under a chair.

Dad comes in and puts his work shoes beside the door. Ronan looks from the shoes to the picture.

“Keep your shoes up high tonight,” he says.

Dad looks at the dog. He lifts both shoes and steps into the room in his socks.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

return＝归还；card＝借阅卡；pairs＝两人组；Tuesday＝星期二。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样把绿书还到借阅角？
2. 老师宣布的双人任务，哪些事情还没有确定？

## 读句子

**Miss Wu / checks / the date.** 吴老师／核对／日期。
